input.command: ls -la dotenv tests && sed -n 1,60p dotenv/main.py 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd /workspace 2>/dev/null || cd .; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -25

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('dotenv/parser.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'return re.sub(r"\\s+#.*", "", part).lstrip()'
new = 'return re.sub(r"\\s+#.*", "", part).strip()'
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
git diff -- dotenv/parser.py 2>/dev/null || sed -n '114,120p' dotenv/parser.py
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = {
 "X=value   \n": "value",
 "Y=word # comment\n": "word",
 "Z=word   # comment   \n": "word",
 "W=a b\t \n": "a b",
 "V=#hash\n": "#hash",
 "U=no#hash   \n": "no#hash",
 "Q=   spaced   \n": "spaced",
}
for text, expected in cases.items():
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    got = rows[0].value
    print(repr(text), '->', repr(got), 'OK' if got == expected else f'EXPECTED {expected!r}')
EOF
ls -R tests dotenv; echo ---; cat tests/test_acceptance.py 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && (git status --short 2>&1 | head -20); echo '--- diff ---'; (git diff 2>&1 | head -40); echo '--- log ---'; (git log --oneline -5 2>&1)

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

cases = [
    "X=value   \n",
    "Y=word # comment\n",
    "A=value\t\n",
    "B=value   # comment with spaces   \n",
    "C=a#b\n",
    "D= spaced\n",
    "E=\n",
    "F=\"quoted   \"\n",
    "G='single   '\n",
    "H=value   \r\n",
]
for c in cases:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(c)))
    print(repr(c), "->", [(r.key, r.value, r.error, r.original.string) for r in rows])
EOF
